channel.title: Hardik Darji — Embedded Systems Blog
channel.description: Notes on embedded C, CAN and J1939, real-time debugging, and firmware performance from a senior embedded engineer.

item.title: My Journey in Embedded Systems
item.description: How I moved from Arduino boards to safety-relevant firmware on off-highway machinery, and what surprised me on the way.
item.author: Hardik Darji (hmdarji921@gmail.com)

item.title: CAN Protocol Best Practices
item.description: Practical habits for implementing and debugging CAN in embedded C, learned from reading traces on real machines with PCAN-Explorer.
item.author: Hardik Darji (hmdarji921@gmail.com)

item.title: Real-time Debugging Techniques
item.description: How I debug firmware when there is no printf, the timing budget is tight, and the failure only happens on the machine.
item.author: Hardik Darji (hmdarji921@gmail.com)

item.title: An Introduction to J1939 Protocol
item.description: A practical overview of the J1939 transport and addressing model, and why it sits on top of CAN rather than replacing it.
item.author: Hardik Darji (hmdarji921@gmail.com)

item.title: Optimizing Embedded Software Performance
item.description: Measuring before optimising, and the small set of changes that usually deliver most of the gain on resource-constrained targets.
item.author: Hardik Darji (hmdarji921@gmail.com)
